findings.message: UPDATE over every row of users in one transaction: the locks are held to the end and a failure part-way rolls all of it back. Make it a backfill step, which commits and checkpoints as it goes
findings.detail: ROW EXCLUSIVE on users, held for a full scan; blocks no traffic
